A '''Clawdite''' lived and worked on the commercial [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Denon/Legends|Denon]], where they met [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], an executive bodyguard. The two briefly settled into family life and had a daughter, [[Sone]].<ref name="Scum" />

Eventually, Wesell found life on a single world too restrictive and left her family to pursue a career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].<ref name="Scum" /> Following Wesell's [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Sone disappeared.<ref name="Scum" />
